title: Planar discs of uniform radius accumulating at an unstable point contradict finite mass
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let C ∈ 𝒟₂(ℝ^P) be integer multiplicity, and let ρ > 0. For i ∈ ℕ let Q_i be linear subspaces of ℝ^P with dim Q_i = 2, z_i ∈ Q_i with z_i → b ∈ ℝ^P, and k_i ∈ ℕ. Assume every x ∈ Q_i ∩ B_ρ(z_i) admits ε > 0 such that spt C ∩ B_ε(x) = Q_i ∩ B_ε(x), HasMassDensity C y k_i for every y ∈ spt C ∩ B_ε(x), and H²(W ∩ Q_i) ≤ M_W(C) for every open W ⊆ B_ε(x). Assume also that b is unstable: there are no ε > 0 and m ∈ ℕ with HasMassDensity C y m for every y ∈ spt C ∩ B_ε(b). Then these hypotheses are contradictory (False).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2) (Q : ℕ → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (z : ℕ → Euclid P) (k : ℕ → ℕ) (b : Euclid P) (ρ : ℝ), IsIntegerMultiplicity C → 0 < ρ → (∀ i, Module.finrank ℝ (Q i) = 2) → (∀ i, z i ∈ Q i) → Tendsto z atTop (𝓝 b) → (∀ i, ∀ x ∈ (Q i : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball (z i) ρ, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ C.support ∩ ball x ε = (Q i : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball x ε ∧ (∀ y ∈ C.support, y ∈ ball x ε → HasMassDensity C y (k i)) ∧ ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → W ⊆ ball x ε → μHE[2] (W ∩ (Q i : Set (Euclid P))) ≤ C.massOn W) → (¬ ∃ (ε : ℝ) (m : ℕ), 0 < ε ∧ ∀ y ∈ C.support, y ∈ ball b ε → HasMassDensity C y m) → False
